children.game_version: Call-and-response stepping game using the mooch and hop steps

seniors.seated_version: Seated hip shifts and hand-on-hip upper body movements
seniors.standing_version: Standing with a support bar, avoiding deep knee bends
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo, restricted range of pelvic motion

movement_profile.footwork: Shuffle forward with both feet; hop down front then doodle back; hobbling break a leg step
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Danced solo or by couples in ballrooms, cabarets, and stages
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Strong forward and backward movements of the pelvis, hips go first then feet during the mooch, and bumping posteriors together
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Hops down front and moves near the ground
movement_profile.partnering: Optional couple dancing with cheeky posterior bumps

signature_moves.description: Shuffle forward with both feet where hips go first, then feet.
signature_moves.name: The Mooch

signature_moves.description: A hobbling step performed until near the ground.
signature_moves.name: Break a Leg

music_profile.sound_description: Syncopated 4/4 jazz music featuring prominent piano, driving rhythm, and playful stomp tempos reminiscent of 1920s revues.

basic_steps: Hop down front then doodle back
Mooch to the left and right with hips leading
Hands on hips and do the mess around
Break a leg hobbling step near the ground
teaching.level_notes: Beginner-friendly social dance steps emphasizing hip coordination and foot shuffles.
